description: This file defines the InlinePrint class within the Twig templating engine, representing an inline print expression node, used during template compilation.

classes.name: InlinePrint
classes.description: A class representing an inline print expression node in the Twig template engine, used for compiling inline variable output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an InlinePrint node with a given child node and line number, issuing a deprecation warning.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the inline print expression into PHP code that yields the node's output during template rendering.
